brief_title: Liraglutide Effectiveness in Preoperative Weight-loss for Bariatric-metabolic Surgery
official_title: Liraglutide Effectiveness in Preoperative Weight-loss for Patients With Severe Obesity Undergoing Bariatric-metabolic Surgery.

arm_groups.label: Patients with morbid obesity in bariatric surgery preparation protocol

brief_summary: Severe obesity is associated with considerable reduction of wellbeing and life expectancy. People living with severe obesity tend to die 8 to 10 years earlier. Preoperative management of patients living with severe obesity can be challenging and proper weight-loss may help obtain better outcomes and less morbidity. The effectiveness of GLP-1 analogue Liraglutide in preoperative weight-loss was evaluated in the study.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with BMI greater than 48 kg/m2 in pre-surgical protocol for bariatric surgery of the Bariatric and Metabolic Surgery Unit of the Civil Hospital of Guadalajara "Dr. Juan I. Menchaca

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under 18 years of age or over 65 years of age.

  * Pregnant patients.
  * Patients who do not agree to give their consent and take part in the study.
  * Patients with allergy to liraglutide, multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 and medullary thyroid cancer, gallstones.

Removal:

* Patients who decide to abandon the study.
* Patients who do not follow the instructions or do not adhere to the treatment.
